name: bilingual_AI_prompt_library
description: A practical bilingual library providing AI prompt templates for prompt engineering to support work, learning, content creation, marketing, and everyday applications.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: The content or subject matter to be used as input for prompt generation or AI interaction.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Target language indicator to select prompts in the desired language (e.g., English or Chinese).

inputs.name: prompt_type
inputs.description: Category or intent of the prompt such as marketing, learning, content creation, or daily tasks.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: Optional key-value pairs for customizing prompt templates with placeholders.

outputs.name: prompt
outputs.description: Generated prompt string tailored for the specified language, context, and use case.

patterns: Bilingual prompt templates with placeholders for dynamic content insertion
Categorization of prompts based on usage scenarios (work, marketing, learning, etc.)
Template-driven prompt engineering approach for easy reuse and customization
steps: Select target language for prompt output.
Identify the use case or category for the prompt (e.g., marketing, content creation).
Provide contextual input or parameters relevant to the prompt's intent.
Process the input to fill placeholders in the selected bilingual prompt template.
Output the completed AI prompt for use in AI models or other applications.
use_cases: Creating customized AI prompts for bilingual content marketing campaigns.
Generating educational prompts for language learning or study aids.
Formulating work-related prompts for task automation or productivity assistance.
Developing daily conversational or creative prompts to enhance AI interaction.
